name: Ochre-fronted Antpitta
rangeDescription: Andes of northern peru (san martín and amazonas)
description: Small, streaky antpitta found only in a small area of the eastern Andes in northern Peru. Note the strongly marked underparts and the white mustache.

name: Barking Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Forest of larger fiji islands
description: A large, long-necked, long-tailed pigeon. Body and tail brown, head and neck gray, throat and chest peachy pink.

name: Collared Treepie
rangeDescription: Himalayas of northern india, northern myanmar, and northwestern vietnam
description: Like many other treepies, this is a noisy, social bird, often seen in flocks moving through the canopy and through openings in the forest. Extensively black face, silver hood, and lack of a wing patch distinguish this species from other treepies in its range.

name: Bob-tailed Weaver
rangeDescription: Southeastern cameroon and banks of congo river system in democratic republic of the congo
description: A small odd finch-like weaver with a short stubby tail. Breeding male has a yellowish crown and breast and a black face mask.

name: Starred Wood-Quail
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of western amazon basin
description: Rotund brown bird of lowland rainforest understory. Reddish brown with small gray spots.

name: Pirre Warbler
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of eastern panama and far northwestern colombia
description: This warbler has an extremely limited range near the border of Panama and Colombia. The head pattern is distinctive; look for the bold white eyebrow and reddish crown.

name: Atlas Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Morocco (south to middle atlas mountains), northern algeria, and northern tunisia
description: Very similar and closely related to European Pied Flycatcher. Males have mixed features of Collared and European Pied Flycatchers, but note very large white wing patch and big white forehead.

name: Rufous-throated Bronze-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of new guinea
description: A small cuckoo of montane rainforest. Compact with a pale rufous throat and underparts with broad dark bands on a white background all the way to the tail.

name: Taiwan Scimitar-Babbler
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Medium-sized, strikingly patterned songbird endemic to Taiwan, where fairly common. Brown above, white below, with white supercilium, black mask, and heavy black spots on the breast.

name: Seychelles White-eye
rangeDescription: Forest of mahé and conception island (seychelles islands); reintroduced to frégate, cousin, and north islands
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Very dull olive-brown in coloration, with conspicuous white “spectacles.” Found locally in forest, woodland, and gardens on some of the granitic Seychelles islands.

name: Flores Minivet
rangeDescription: Western lesser sundas (sumbawa and flores)
description: A small, long-tailed songbird that perches upright. Male is largely black with white underparts, a contrasting red breast patch, red wing markings, and a red rump and outer tail feathers.

name: Black-fronted Tern
rangeDescription: South island; disperses to stewart and north islands (new zealand)
description: A medium to small blue-gray tern endemic to New Zealand. Breeding birds have a black cap extending down to the bill and bright orange bill and legs.

name: Gray Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds western north america; winters to southern mexico
description: Drab, pale-gray flycatcher with little plumage contrast; very similar to other flycatchers, especially Dusky and Hammond's. Often best identified by unique habit of wagging tail downward.

name: Dickinson's Kestrel
rangeDescription: Palms and savanna of east-central and northeastern south africa
description: Medium-sized gray kestrel. Note the pale head, rump, and underwing, which are conspicuous in flight.

name: Vegetarian Finch
rangeDescription: Main islands of galapagos (except for more arid islands)
description: A large and rather parrot-billed Galápagos finch. Bill is about as long as it is deep, with a very round upper edge and slightly curved lower edge.

name: Kikuyu White-eye
rangeDescription: Central kenya (aberdare mountains and mount kenya)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the olive-green back, the yellow underparts with broad olive flanks, and the very broad white spectacles around the eyes.

name: Rufous-banded Owl
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to venezuela, ecuador, peru, and bolivia
description: Uncommon medium-sized owl found in the subtropical and temperate zones of the Andes from Venezuela to Bolivia. Patterned with rufous, dark brown, and white overall.

name: Variable Oystercatcher
rangeDescription: Coasts and islands of new zealand
description: A large, stocky shorebird endemic to New Zealand. Adults vary in color from all black to pied, with a range of intermediate morphs in between.

name: White-cheeked Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Montane forest of vietnam and southern laos
description: A garrulous, sociable bird, often found in large flocks, both single-species and mixed. Warm brown with a gray crown, a broad black mask, and a luminously white cheek spot, and long white-tipped tail.

name: Band-bellied Crake
rangeDescription: Northeastern asia; winters in southeastern asia and greater sundas
description: Skulky and difficult to see, this medium-sized crake is often detected through its unique song, a hollow hoot-knocking that can be likened to a wood rattle or rapidfire tapping on a tiny high-pitched drum. Favors extremely well-vegetated marsh margins, often in areas with bushes and short trees, and sometimes near cultivation.
